3. High Violation Inspection (Mar 18, 2025): Score of 50 with 9 critical items, including holding expired potentially hazardous foods (heavy whipping cream and cooked beef ribs past expiration date, code 4.3.61) and uncorrected handwashing soap/drying provision failures.
